senses.gloss: भाषा- + परिच्छेद भाषा- + परिच्छेद, m. title of a philosophical work; definition of (the categories of) speech.

भष् भष्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 2, 1425).
 1. To bark, MBh. 1, 5249.
 2. To bark at, to reproach malevolently, to rail, 3, 15641; cf. भाष्.

भस् भस्, ii. 3, Par.
 1. To eat.
 2. To shine.
 3. † To blame. भसित, see s. v.; cf. प्सा and भा.

भाष् भाष्, i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., Chr. 27, 1).
 1. To speak, Man. 8, 216.
 2. To speak to (acc.), Rām. 2, 78, 19.
 3. To address, MBh. 3, 2747.
 4. To describe, Man. 4, 255. भाषित, n. Speech, Pañc. i. d. 356.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To speak distinctly, Man. 3, 30.
 2. To confess, Man. 11, 228.
 --With अप अप, To revile, Kumāras. 5, 83.
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To address, Man. 2, 128.
 2. To speak to (with instr.), Man. 4, 57.
 3. To declare loudly, Man. 11, 103.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, To converse, MBh. 3, 12697.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To address, MBh. 1, 74. []
 2. To speak, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 396.
 3. To exclaim, Dev. 2, 36.
 --With व्या वि-आ, To address, MBh. 3, 15169.
 --Comp. ptcple. दुःख-व्याभाषित, adj. Difficult to be pronounced, MBh. 13, 4485.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To address, MBh. 1, 4198.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To declare, Utt. Rāmac. 130, 5.
 2. To persuade, MBh. 1, 4287.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To speak, Rām. 3, 51, 25.
 2. To address, MBh. 3, 2599. प्रभाषित, n. Speech, Nal. 8, 11.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To speak, MBh. 5, 41.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To answer, MBh. 3, 2524.
 2. To address, Rām. 1, 8, 29; Pañc. 193, 13.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To converse, Chr. 56, 18; to converse with (instr.), Man. 8, 55.
 2. To have sexual intercourse with, Hit. 64, 12 (with acc.).
 3. To greet, Hit. 14, 20.
 4. To speak. MBh. 1, 5190; to say, Hit. 57, 6 (read संभाषते. The sense is: It is true he is anxious, else he would not have said to me, etc.). भाष् is probably akin to भा.
 --Cf. Lat. fastus, nefastus, nefarius, festus, feriæ, hariolus, fas, nefas, fari; ϕημί, ϕάσις, ϕατός, ϕήμη, ϕωνή; akin are ϕθέγγομαι, ϕθέγμα (but cf. भञ्ज्, i. 10); A.S. bannan, abannan.

1. भास् भास् (akin to भा, probably a denomin.), i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 1, 4852).
 1. To shine, MBh. 3, 12299.
 2. To appear, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 4.
 --Caus.
 1. To illuminate, Bhagav. 15, 6.
 2. To make evident, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 22.
 --With the prep. अव अव,
 1. To shine, Rām. 1, 35, 16.
 2. To appear, Vedāntas. in Chr. 212, 12.
 --Caus. To illuminate, Śiś. 9, 37.
 --With आ आ, To shine, MBh. 2, 1313.
 --With उद् उद्, Caus.
 1. To beautify, Ragh. 7, 16.
 2. To honour, Bhartṛ. 2, 49.
 --With नि नि, To seem likely.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To shine, MBh. 3, 17090.
 2. To seem likely.
 --Caus. To illuminate, MBh. 1, 6532.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To reflect, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 15.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To shine agreeably, Rām. 2, 30, 10.
 2. To shine, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 88; 595.

2. भास् भास्, f.
 1. Light, Ṛt. 6, 33.
 2. A ray of light, Rājat. 5, 343.
 3. Splendour, Pañc. i. d. 213.
 4. Image, Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 38.
 5. Wish.
 --Comp.
भष भष् + अ, m. A dog. f. षी, A bitch.

भाषा भाष् + आ, f.
 1. Speech, Chr. 220, 1. 1.
 2. Language, Pañc. i. d. 445.
 3. Vernacular speech, Lass. 39, 11; MBh. 2, 2040.
 4. Speech exposing the plaint in a law-suit, Lass. 90, 3; Pañc. 167, 6(?).
 --Comp.

भास भास् + अ,
 I. m., and f. सा, Light.
 II. m.
 1. A vulture, Man. 11, 135; Pañc. 157, 3(?).
 2. A cock.
 3. A sort of water-fowl.
 4. A station of cowherds.
 --Comp.
भषक भष + क, m. A dog.
भासक भास् + अक, adj. Making evident, Vedāntas. in Chr. 211, 22.

भसद् भसद्, f.
 1. Pudendum muliebre.
 2. The sun.
 3. A month.
भसन्त भसन्त, m. Time.

भासन्त भासन्त् + अ (vb. भास्),
 I. adj.
 1. Shining.
 2. Beautiful.
 II. m.
 1. The sun.
 2. The moon.
 3. A kind of water-fowl.
भसित भसित, n. Ashes.
भस्त्रका भस्त्रका, see भस्त्राका.

भस्त्राका भस्त्राका, भस्त्रका भस्त्रका, भस्त्रिका भस्त्रिका, i. e. भस्त्रा + क or इक, f.
 1. A bellows.
 2. भस्त्रिका, A bag, Daśak. in Chr. 189, 2 (चर्म-रत्न-, a most wonderful leather bag).

भस्त्रा भस्त्रा, f.
 1. A bellows, Pañc. iii. d. 97.
 2. A bag, Pañc. 265, 8.

भस्मक भस्मक, n.
 1. A disease of the eyes, indistinctness of vision.
 2. (i. e. भस् + मन् + क), Morbid appetite with general decay.
भस्मन् भस्मन् (cf. भसित), n. Ashes, Hit. ii. d. 163.
भस्मसात् भस्मसात्, i. e. भस्मन् + सात्, adv. Completely into ashes; with नी and कृ, To reduce to ashes, Pañc. 38, 18; 186, 14; Utt. Rāmac. 74, 3.
भस्मी भस्मी, see कृ and भू.
भाषण भाषण, i. e. भाष् + अन, n. Speech, Lass. 8, 8.

भाषिन् भाष् + इन्, adj., f. षिणी, Speaking, Pañc. 184, 4; Rājat. 5, 61. []
 --Comp.
भासिन् भास् + इन्, adj. Shining, Hariv. 985.
भासता भास + ता, f. Condition of a vulture, Man. 11, 25.

भासुर भासुर (= भास्वर),
 I. adj. Shining, Bhartṛ. 2, 27.
 II. m.
 1. Crystal.
 2. A hero.
भासुरक भासुर + क, m. A proper name, Pañc. 53, 17.
भासुरत्व भासुर + त्व, n. Splendour, Mālav. d. 12.

भास्कर भास्-कर,
 I. adj. Resplendent.
 II. m.
 1. The sun, Pañc. 190, 4.
 2. Fire.
 3. A hero.
 III. n. Gold.
भास्यत्व भास्य + त्व (vb. भास्), n. Condition of appearing, Vedāntas. in Chr. 211, 19.

भास्वन्त् भास् + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Shining, Man. 1, 77; radiant, Chr. 294, 7 = Rigv. i. 92, 7.
 II. m.
 1. Light.
 2. The sun, Pañc. iii. d. 77.
 3. A hero.
 III. f. वती, The city of the sun.

भास्वर भास्वर, i. e. भास्वन् (curtailed ˚वन्त्), + अ (with र् for न्),
 I. adj. Shining, Bhāṣāp. 40; radiant.
 II. m.
 1. The sun.
 2. A day.
